# Élan Summit

> Élan Summit is a premium inter-school event in Pune, Maharashtra, India, held on 5–6 September 2026 at the SGI Pune Campus (Sanjay Ghodawat International School). It is primarily for school students aged 14 to 19; first-year university students within the same age range are also eligible and may register individually.

Élan's two flagship competitions run at the same time; each participant takes part in one:
- **Crisis Command** — a two-day crisis leadership simulation where mixed-school teams lead a fictional nation through briefing, escalation and a final response.
- **Cent$ible** — an inter-school business arena with four themes (BRAND बनाओ, VIRAL व्यापार, NOTE नीति, प्रश्न PRODIGY), an in-event currency called Cents, and a Boardroom Finale.

Beyond the flagships, Élan includes live performances, competitions, guest sessions, networking, a cultural night and school delegations.

## Tickets (https://elansummit.com/tickets.html)
- Early Bird — ₹3,699
- Standard — ₹4,199
- Late Registration — ₹4,899
- School Delegation Pack — ₹18,999
